purpose: Root-cause measurements for the aug06 cross-set compose corner star smear (COMPOSE_SMEAR_INVESTIGATION_report.md). Every number here is a tool's: darktable-cli (the production warp), Siril findstar/seqtilt, astrometry.net (solve_field.py, sip_order=3), run_undistort_compose.sh (the production compose).

normalisation_probe.instrument: seeded synthetic star-field fixture at sensor geometry 6064x4040 (150 gaussian dots, 400 px pitch -> matching unambiguous to 200 px); darktable-cli --style lensdist vs --style nodist (styles differ ONLY in the module's enabled bit); Siril findstar per quadrant crop
normalisation_probe.verdict: HALF THE SHORT SIDE (2020 px). Frame corner therefore at rho = 1.80 while cpfind control points constrain the fit only to rho <= 1.0 — 80% extrapolation at the corners.

member_disagreement_px.instrument: register s -2pass + setref + seqapplyreg -framing=min, then Siril findstar on EACH registered member separately, mutual-nearest match (tol 12 px); median separation of the SAME star as the two members place it, by canvas zone (fractions of half-diagonal)

aug06_cross_ONE_model_s01_s02.note: byte-identical group membership to the row above (all 13 g*.list diff IDENTICAL); ONE KNOB = the installed model

cross_night_j31s01_a06s01pinned_ONE_mode.note: X1 cell (sessions/aug06/work/smear_arm/X1): july31 s01 sub_01 + aug06 s01-PINNED sub_01, both warped under the identical pinned model, so the separation is the pure between-night optical-state difference (the shared model cancels: (D_A-M)-(D_B-M)=D_A-D_B). Whole-frame match (not regional crops), same zones/tol as the A-cells. CONSEQUENCE: a shared family model does NOT extend across nights - 4.07 px corner exceeds the 2.99 own-models failure; F1-as-shared-model is same-night-scoped, and multi-night composition requires corner-true PER-STATE fits (F2).

member_residual_distortion_sip.instrument: astrometry.net via scripts/calibrate/solve_field.py (sip_order=3); displacement of the injected TAN-SIP polynomial over a 25x25 grid

star_shape_fwhm_px.instrument: Siril findstar, open gate (-roundness=0.10 -relax=on -maxR=1.0), 800 px boxes, (FWHMx+FWHMy)/2 median, green layer
star_shape_fwhm_px.note: RECORDED BUT NOT VERDICT-BEARING for this defect — a PSF fitter fits one component of a doubled star, not the blend (docs/dead-ends.md). Kept for continuity with the prior audit.

seqtilt.note: MEASURED BLIND to this defect: off-axis aberration 0.34 px for the FAILING union vs 0.40 px for the PASSING july31 union.

singles_control.reading: the raws are comparable and aug06's are marginally MORE field-uniform — the aug06 member corner degradation is introduced by the chain, not inherited from the optics
